queries_run: Cencora Walgreens contract second source OR in-house distribution 2026
Cencora Evernorth customer diversify supplier single-source risk 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 揭露客戶集中：Walgreens 與 Boots 合計約占營收 25%、Evernorth 約 13%、前十大客戶約 66%；並警告關鍵客戶或 GPO 合約可能到期未續、被終止或以較差條件續約。一手文件未載明客戶導入第二供應商或自製。
findings.excerpt: Walgreens and Boots together accounted for approximately 25% of our revenue in fiscal 2025 and, as of September 30, 2025, accounted for approximately 38% of our accounts receivable, net. Evernorth Health Services accounted for approximately 13% of our revenue in fiscal 2025. Our top ten customers, including governmental agencies, represented approximately 66% of revenue in fiscal 2025.

customer_second_source.note: 兩次搜尋未見第二供應商、合約終止或客戶自建配送的來源。搜尋摘要（聚合站 Parqet，無法逐字取得原文）提到 Walgreens 自 2026-07-01 起把部分業務量移到合作框架之外，Cencora 稱主供應協議仍涵蓋多數業務且已反映於 8-5 揭露、維持 FY2026 調整後 EPS 指引 17.75–17.95 美元；此為部分量轉移，非確認的第二供應商，未核原文故不列為 finding。
